scripts.db:truncate: docker compose exec postgres psql -U wallop_user -d wallop_database -c "truncate table credit_transactions, sessions, otp_codes, oauth_accounts, oauth_states, users cascade;"
scripts.db:test:create: docker compose exec postgres psql -U wallop_user -d wallop_database -c "CREATE DATABASE wallop_test;" || true
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && sleep 5 && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:test:create
